graph.v_import_graph_degree.sql: SELECT COALESCE("t4"."repo", "t3"."repo") AS "repo", COALESCE("t4"."commit", "t3"."commit") AS "commit", COALESCE("t4"."src_module", "t3"."dst_module") AS "module", COALESCE("t4"."import_out_degree", 0) AS "import_out_degree", COALESCE("t3"."import_in_degree", 0) AS "import_in_degree" FROM (SELECT "t0"."repo", "t0"."commit", "t0"."src_module", COUNT("t0"."dst_module") AS "import_out_degree" FROM graph__import_graph_edges AS "t0" GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) AS "t4" FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT "t0"."repo", "t0"."commit", "t0"."dst_module", COUNT("t0"."src_module") AS "import_in_degree" FROM graph__import_graph_edges AS "t0" GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) AS "t3" ON "t4"."repo" = "t3"."repo" AND "t4"."commit" = "t3"."commit" AND "t4"."src_module" = "t3"."dst_module"
